entries.text: The logs page can clear the logs
The statistics page draws the recent speed as a curve
The rule set and subscription texts no longer name Xray
A connectivity test by ICMP ping
Text scale following the system is no longer too large, and a custom scale moves in 1% steps or can be typed in
The icon beside Not connected is grey while the proxy is off
A subscription's menu, on a right click or a long press, can change its link, hide it or paste servers into it
Swiping a subscription offers test and update, or its QR code and delete
A subscription's nodes open more softly, one row after another
A subscription's nodes slide open and closed
Scrolling the home page brings up the logo in the bar, which turns the proxy on and off
Global routing and connectivity test have new icons on the home page
The access control app list no longer leaves a gap at its top on phones
Android sees com.flclash as another app, so it does not update an installed com.follow.clash and does not carry its data over. Intents sent to com.follow.clash.action.* need the new prefix.
A new config page sets up routing rules from presets, or starts an empty config
Traditional Chinese
The language setting shows a globe icon
Long-pressing a node lifts it and opens its menu beside it, as on iOS
Access control and other pages load with the iOS spinner
Empty pages show a plain iOS-style glyph
Swipe actions fade out one by one as a row slides shut
The Android app is now installed as com.flclash, beside rather than over the old com.follow.clash
Appearance colors can be picked from a palette as well as typed
Choice pages close as soon as an option is picked
Read a node's country off its domain
The network check row shows a long IPv6 address shortened instead of filling the row
Do not place a line of the subscription's notes by its address
Ask a second GeoIP service when the first has no answer
Place a line of the subscription's notes by its own address again
Resolve the flag of a domain node behind a fake-IP resolver
Drop the icons that subscription info lines were given
Take back the flags and icons given to subscription info lines
The update dialog shows the release notes in an iOS style
Windows now has default hotkeys, on Ctrl+Alt+Shift plus a letter
The macOS menu bar menu is plainer and its speed reads 0.3K/s↑
The hotkey page can reset all hotkeys to their defaults
Every hotkey action has a default combination on macOS and Linux
Network detection shows an IP purity score, refreshes by pulling down on mobile and no longer lists the source
Update checks and the links in About now point to this repository's releases
The code editor starts right under the title bar on every platform
The log page no longer leaves a blank band in its card on phones
Saving a profile's settings now shows a confirmation
Network detection and service checks also work while the proxy is off
The DNS page keeps Manual once saved, even with the default servers
Servers addressed by domain name now connect, for every protocol
Flags for subscription info lines and more node names, round flags in the macOS menu bar, a more compact interface, and a home page that keeps its controls when there is no subscription
The home toolbar sync button spins while the profile updates
Delay tests work with the proxy off; drop the delay failure log (#12)
Buzz the Android vibrator itself and log why a delay test failed (#11)
IOS-style swipe rows, menus, dialogs, switches and settings sizing (#10)
Drag a node row all the way across to test or delete it, with a tick when armed
Node forms follow Xray's options with Transport and TLS pages, a Configure DNS page is added, and subscription errors show as notices
Use a heavier haptic for the proxy toggle so Android devices feel it
Replace the mihomo core with Xray-core
Several subscriptions can be expanded at once, and choosing a node in another one switches to it
The bottom tab bar on phones is frosted glass with outlined icons and larger labels
Node rows swipe right to test or copy a node and left to show its QR code or delete it
Turning the proxy on or off from the home screen vibrates while haptic feedback is on
Haptic feedback opens its own page with On and Off and a description
Rule configs have a right-click menu to rename, edit, edit as plain text or delete, and the default config can be edited
The config tab holds Xray rule configs that can be written by hand, imported, downloaded or tested
Android has a haptic feedback switch under Other in the settings
The sidebar can be resized by dragging its edge
The URL Schemes page lists links to start, stop, toggle, switch server, add a server, test connectivity, update subscriptions and switch routing
The tray menu lists the current upload and download speed under the speed view on macOS when the menu bar shows none
The speed beside the menu bar icon is off by default and appears once the speed view is toggled
The tray menu has a checkbox for the TUN virtual network card
The global routing page has a switch for the TUN virtual network card on desktop
Text fields open the system's own Cut, Copy and Paste menu on desktop
Subscriptions are now fetched as Vex by default, and the v2rayNG user agent is no longer listed
A clearer settings page with tunnel, permissions, reset and about sections
Clipboard import, shareable color schemes, and in-place editing of settings
Choose a server's flag by hand or have it found from its address, and icons for the notes in a subscription
Statistics, server editing and reset pages, a menu bar mode and sidebar switch, and a consistent look across settings
Node flags are now round images that look the same on every platform
A Shadowrocket-style interface, manual server entry for ten protocols, and Hysteria 1 support
The proxies page lists nodes directly, and choosing a node rewrites the running config
Replace the mihomo core with Xray-core
Remove the disclaimer and its consent screen
Node rows no longer repeat the flag emoji next to the round flag
Bring a v4 database from before the schema rebuild up to date
Editor word wrap and snippets
More dashboard cards
Hide timed-out nodes and search every list
Sidebar, floating dock and drag to go back
New app glyphs, empty states and theme page
Invalid override warnings and rule presets
DNS query log and per-key DNS/NTP overrides
Proxied service checks and outbound IP risk
Tray hotkeys, node delays and a delay test
A changed resource link is now used by the next sync and by auto update
DNS lookups no longer fail on networks that report no DNS servers
Smaller icons in icon-only group headers
Push notifications reconnect in Doze
Restores never apply halfway
Refresh the geo file size and time after an update finishes
Keep the core running while Windows sleeps with the app suspended
Rework the app UI and refresh the localization
Rework the app layer and window handling, and add proxy authentication
Rework the desktop runners, packaging, and native build
Rework the Android VPN service and lifecycle handling
Rework the desktop plugins and add the Helper service and Rust bridge
Rework the core IPC and process lifecycle
